name: Goel Food Products Ltd.
summary: Incorporated in 1996, Goel Food Products Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing Indian snacks and sweets. The company provides services such as organizing events like marriages, sangeet, and corporate events at its banquet halls. It also serves Indian snacks and sweets at its retail shops and generates rental income from hotels and guest houses. The company operates its banquet and retail business under the name "BIKA" in various locations in Kolkata.
